temporal_proof.groups: Each thread commits Q0=0, K_t=2t+1 and V_t=2t+2. Before K_t conversion latest committed group is V_t; wait1 completes Q0 and K_t locally. Before V_t conversion latest is K_(t+1); wait1 completes V_t locally. Empty committed groups follow the same ordering.
temporal_proof.conversion: The proposed converter reads only payload slots copied by the same thread. It preserves the vector cast and exact BF16 output coordinates; its existing following full CTA barrier publishes all completed Q loads and converted tile writes to all matrix consumers.
temporal_proof.retirement: Existing full CTA barriers after QK/softmax and after PV remain: they retire K/V stage readers before the other role overwrites the shared conversion stage and before the compressed role is overwritten. Final wait0/full CTA and output synchronization remain.
temporal_proof.eligibility: RoPE, VO splits, time-shared K/V, FP4, CTA16, k64B and sub128-byte logical rows retain the original converter assignment and pre-conversion barriers. Short-K64 retains its physical padded row/zeroing/source stride; a full128-byte V role is independently eligible.
temporal_proof.no_other_dependency: In eligible POS_ENCODING=kNone/non-split paths, no intervening cross-thread shared reads occur between the conditional pre-barrier and owned conversion. K/V native math and all published row/layout values are unchanged.

primary_reference.rule: Async groups and their completion are per issuing thread; a completed wait makes that thread's copies visible to it. The retained post-conversion CTA barrier is still required for cross-thread publication.

finite_fix: Use one private constexpr eligibility predicate, reindex existing full-row FP8 conversion by the exact producer assignment, and condition the pre-K/pre-V CTA barriers in the original ragged and paged loops on that predicate. Keep every cp.async operation/commit/wait, all post-conversion/retirement/final/output barriers and the old converter path outside eligibility. No new algorithm, precision, storage, tile, pipeline depth, planner or public API.
rejection: Direct removal of current pre-conversion barriers is unsafe: D256 currently has240/256cross-thread source reads. Ownership alignment is inseparable from barrier coalescing.
limits: Source/spatial/temporal proof plus already captured diagnostic trace only; no new profile, runtime or throughput verdict.
Fresh source17/device22/codegen/SDK/numeric-runtime/host/originalP1 gates are required; all three workloads remain mandatory.
This record does not authorize product edits before the card fixes the finiteFIX and FI legally transitions to AUDITED; all old failures/costs remain.
